vLLM serve flags: dtype float16, generation-config vllm, served-model-name Qwen/Qwen2-7B-Instruct. The batch-invariant arm set VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT=1. Other flags stayed at stock defaults.
FlashInfer 0.6.16 on Python 3.11 rejected one annotation, array.array[int]. That annotation was edited to array.array. The sampling code was not changed.
ninja 1.13.2 is installed in the vLLM virtualenv. It was put on PATH so FlashInfer could compile its sampler during startup.
The server tokenize route and the installed tokenizer's chat template both produced 214 ids for the echo prompt, and those ids matched.
The Luxi gate binary was left unchanged. The echo rows came from a second binary built for this measurement. No transport error was discarded.
